label: Contingent concrete beings have temporal presence somewhere in their histories
term: temporal manifestation of contingent concrete being
definition: For each history v accessible from w, any individual x that is concrete and modal-contingent at v is present at some moment of that history: there exists t with history.IsAt v x t. It is weaker than CoherentAtNow, does not require a first moment, and leaves necessary or timeless sources unrestricted. Without it a contingent but temporally uninstantiated source need not belong to the memberwise causal domain quantified by ConcurrentTotalityGivingAt.
note: Explicit missing ontic-existence-to-temporal-presence bridge. A structural model with a source existing but never IsAt can separate the inference. Applicable temporal concreta vs atemporal contingent concreta remain a philosophical scope choice.
